title: UK Business Database 2026: Structured Sample of 100 Active United Kingdom Corporate Entities (Ltd, PLC, LLP) with UK SIC 2007 & Royal Mail Postcodes
description:
Official 100-row, 14-column open benchmark sample of the 2026 United Kingdom Corporate Business Directory (235,899 active UK Ltd, PLC, and LLP companies), curated and maintained by UK Business Databases.

Each record includes the verified Companies House Registration Number (CRN), legal structure, 5-digit UK SIC 2007 code, industry classification, full Royal Mail postcode, ONS region, TPS-screened corporate switchboard number, generic corporate email channel (compliant with UK GDPR Recital 14 and PECR Regulation 22), active corporate website URL, and employee/turnover band.

Full national and regional datasets are available at https://ukbusinessdatabases.club/uk-companies-databases/ and the free sample portal at https://ukbusinessdatabases.club/downloads/free-uk-companies-list/.
